item.title: Head of Employee Experience
item.description:
In this Head of Employee Experience role, you'll be…

  • Setting the vision and one roadmap for our Employee Experience across the employee journey, so colleagues experience one Formalize in every office and every new country.

  • Building a scalable, intuitive model where people, systems, processes, IT and offices simply work, so day-to-day operations run smoothly on their own, freeing up your team to give personal, high-touch support when it matters most

  • Setting up one front door for every question on people, workplace and IT, with one ticketing system and a shared knowledge base, solving most questions through self-serve and the rest first time.

  • Leading a team of around ten across People Operations, Workplace and Internal IT with clear ownership, and making your team's time here a real springboard for their HR careers.

  • Owning workplace standards, vendors and budgets, and opening new offices on time and on budget from one playbook.

  • Working with our People Business Partners and Talent Acquisition on journeys that cross teams, such as onboarding and country launches.

Who is the Employee Experience team?

Employee Experience is the team that treats our colleagues like our best customers. We bring People Operations, Workplace, and Internal IT together under one roof because a great workday relies on all three: a contract and conversations that make sense, an office where we celebrate wins together, and a laptop that works from hour one.

Within People Operations, a back office sets standards, systems and automation, while People Operations Partners in the front office are the daily face for colleagues. Our People Business Partners, focused on managers and leaders, work closely with us.

Our principle is high touch where it matters, effortless everywhere else, with one front door for every question and the ambition that colleagues hardly need us.

What you bring

  • Proven leadership experience across the broader employee experience spectrum, combining People Operations with workplace and internal IT, ideally in a scaling international tech company.

  • A builder's instinct. Your energy comes from systems, standards and support models that work every day. Events and celebrations matter but aren't the core, so if confetti is what drives you, this probably isn't your role.

  • You think in models, linking the structural basis to the human interaction it enables, and you know where high personal-touch adds value and where good design does the job better.

  • Strong on digital: people systems, automation and AI are how the team scales, and you're comfortable owning tooling decisions and the budget behind them.

  • A strong sense of fairness and consistency, with standards explicit enough to guide people rather than slow them down.

  • A hands-on leader who builds teams across disciplines and grows people into bigger roles.

  • Clear communication in English, the credibility to partner effectively with our leadership team, and the ability to work from our Copenhagen office (or Aarhus).

What do we offer you?

  • A monthly salary ranging from 65,000 to 70,000 DKK.

  • Continuous development through a clear and transparent career framework, so you always know what the next step looks like, with biannual growth talks and regular check-ins.

  • Thorough pre- and onboarding to set you up for success.

  • A culture of ownership, trust and independence, with the support you need.

  • An office-first culture in a central location in Copenhagen or Aarhus, with benefits including pension, lunch, health insurance and social events.

  • A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

  • Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects.

Our recruitment process

  • Send your application and upload relevant information

  • 15–30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team

  • 30-minute interview with our Hiring Manager

  • 30-minute interview with our interim Head of Talent Acquisition

  • Completion of Personality Assessment

  • In-person team workshop in Aarhus with representatives of People Operations, Workplace and Internal IT, where you work on a real case such as our future onboarding

About Formalize

Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Munich and Madrid. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from +30 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learning from our mistakes, and growing together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy. Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

Ready to apply?

We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

item.title: Office Caretaker (Aarhus)
item.description:
Danish version (English version below)

  • Arbejde tæt sammen med vores Office Coordinator om daglige reparationsopgaver og ad hoc-udfordringer i bygningen.

  • Samle kontormøbler, hænge whiteboards op, montere udstyr og sikre, at mødelokalerne altid fungerer optimalt.

  • Udføre rutinemæssige eftersyn af faciliteter, lys, døre og installationer, så problemer løses, før de forstyrrer kollegerne.

  • Koordinere med eksterne håndværkere og teknikere, når der er behov for specialiserede reparationer eller eftersyn.

  • Et solidt håndelag, hvor du har "hænderne skruet ordentligt på", samt praktisk erfaring med håndværk, bygningsvedligeholdelse eller pedelopgaver.

  • En praktisk, selvstændig og serviceminded tilgang med stolthed i at holde omgivelserne pæne og velfungerende.

  • Grundlæggende kommunikationsevner på dansk eller engelsk, så du nemt kan koordinere med teamet på kontoret.

  • Mulighed for at arbejde 8 faste timer om ugen på vores kontor i Aarhus samt fleksibilitet til op til 8 ekstra buffertimer ved behov.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

  • Personalegoder, herunder frokostordning, sundhedsforsikring og sociale arrangementer.

  • Performing routine inspections of facilities, lights, doors, and installations to solve problems before they disrupt colleagues.

  • Coordinating with external craftspeople and technicians when specialised repairs or inspections are needed.

What you’ll bring:

  • Practical craftsmanship where you have "hænderne skruet ordentligt på", with hands-on experience in trade work, facility maintenance, or handy tasks.

  • A practical, independent, and service-minded approach with pride in keeping surroundings orderly and functioning.

  • Availability to work 8 fixed hours per week on-site at our Aarhus office, with flexibility for up to 8 additional buffer hours when needed.

What do we offer you?

  • An hourly salary for 8 guaranteed hours per week, plus flexibility for up to 8 additional hours when needed.

item.title: Office Coordinator (Aarhus)
item.description:

  • Varetage den daglige frokostordning for omkring 70 medarbejdere, herunder anretning, afrydning og opvask i samarbejde med vores lokale frokostleverandør, samt sørge for at kontoret altid er fyldt op med snacks og forsyninger.

item.title: Director of Legal (Copenhagen)
item.description:
In this Director of Legal role, you’ll be…

  • Serving as the legal partner to Sales by driving commercial SaaS contracting, handling T&Cs, MSAs, and DPAs, negotiating deviations, and maintaining fallback negotiation playbooks.

  • Managing corporate legal matters, including entity management across international markets, governance, board support, and selective coordination with external counsel.

  • Supporting the company's compliance framework in close partnership with our existing Compliance function, with a path toward taking over internal compliance ownership in the near future.

  • Owning vendor and supplier contracting by reviewing and negotiating key terms on liability, security, privacy, and SLAs alongside Finance and Operations.

  • Building and scaling a lean legal operating model by proactively driving processes, internal guidance, and review triggers to keep legal operations efficient.

  • Supporting fundraising rounds, corporate structuring, and M&A initiatives in close collaboration with the CFO and leadership team.

Who is the Legal Team?

Sitting within Finance & Operations, the Legal function drives our overall legal direction while remaining hands-on in building a scalable framework that supports our rapid growth across European markets. We safeguard the company across commercial SaaS contracting, corporate law, international scaling, and vendor management, while supporting future fundraising and M&A activities.

We act as a close partner to executive stakeholders, Sales, Finance, and Security, balancing fast risk-reward decisions with robust corporate governance. You will work directly with the Chief Financial Officer and lead our Corporate Lawyer in an environment that values extreme ownership, pragmatic decision-making, and strong cross-functional collaboration to enable business velocity.

Essentially, we contribute to our vision by protecting the business and providing the legal backbone needed to scale our platform across international markets safely and efficiently.

What you’ll bring:

  • Ideally, +5-10 years of relevant legal experience in a similar role, with proven exposure to a fast-growing SaaS environment that has scaled internationally.

  • A hands-on, autonomous mindset with the drive to take full ownership of the legal function and scale it from the current setup.

  • Strong expertise in commercial SaaS contracting and negotiating client-facing terms.

  • GDPR and data privacy expertise, with experience maintaining compliance frameworks.

  • Experience with corporate law and governance (board and shareholder matters, entity management), plus exposure to fundraising and M&A processes alongside external counsel.

  • A pragmatic, business-oriented mindset with a strong grasp of risk-reward balance to keep sales velocity high while protecting the business.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with fluency in English (Danish is not a requirement).

What do we offer you?

  • A starting salary of 115,000 DKK per month. As you grow within this role, your compensation can grow with you up to 130,000 DKK per month.

item.title: Partner Manager - Norway
item.description:
In this Partner Manager role, you’ll be…

  • Accountable for driving market entry and growth across the new Norwegian market by facilitating end-to-end sales cycles (from lead to closed-won) in close collaboration with an enterprise-grade partner ecosystem and an internal team of experienced Account Executives.

  • A strategic partner builder and commercial lighthouse, establishing executive-level relationships with directors at top audit firms, consultancies, and legal specialists, alongside leading solution-oriented direct selling.

  • Driving revenue impact through dual channels, taking ownership of direct pipeline while co-designing structured partner motions (onboarding, enablement, deal support) to hit both direct and partner-sourced targets.

  • Manage large partner-related projects, in close collaboration with internal product experts, Marketing, Sales Enablement and Revenue Operations.

  • A trusted domain advisor and cross-functional collaborator, enabling partners and prospects on complex frameworks (e.g. NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001, GDPR) while staying closely aligned with the regional strategies in coordination with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Leadership.

Who is the Partner Management Team?

The Partner Management Team is instrumental in strengthening Formalize’s partner-led go-to-market strategy as we build the leading European platform for Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC). Focused on the Nordic region, we build, structure, and scale enterprise-grade ecosystems across audit firms, advisory consultancies, legal specialists, and boutique partners.
We don't do transactional channel management - we drive strategic, revenue-relevant alignment. By connecting partner- and director-level stakeholders externally with our internal Sales, Product, and Leadership teams, we build pipeline, deep credibility, and long-term value in an increasingly complex market of regulations, standards and resilience best practices.
